title: pseudognaphalium microcephalum var. thermale
intro: Pseudognaphalium microcephalum var. thermale, commonly known as Hot Spring Pearly Everlasting, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is characterized by its small, white flowers and silvery-gray foliage. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hot Spring Pearly Everlasting include its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial activities, making it a promising candidate for wound healing and skin care applications. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
